about_the_game:
In this visual novel, you can shape the story through your choices, decide which characters to pursue a romantic relationship with, and reach one of five possible endings.

As the young prince of Fescillia, you arrive in the snowbound land of Klodan—a kingdom veiled in frost and silence. Sent as the king’s envoy to broker peace, you expect diplomacy, tradition, and civility. But Klodan is not what it seems.

Shadows linger in the frozen corridors of its castles. Whispers curl through the wind, speaking of forgotten oaths and buried truths. The people’s smiles never quite reach their eyes.

And then… something impossible happens.

As the cold tightens its grip and reality begins to unravel, you must navigate a treacherous web of secrets, deception, and forces beyond comprehension. Five paths unfold before you—each leading to a different fate. Some lead to peace. Others… to something far darker.

But one truth remains buried in the ice.

Will you uncover it before it consumes you?

GAME FEATURES

• 22+ unique locations across the snowbound kingdom of Klodan

• 5 endings shaped by your choices and actions

• 2 romanceable characters with deep, intertwining stories

• A web of secrets and intrigue waiting to be unraveled

• Original atmospheric soundtrack enhancing the mystery

• A hidden storyline for those who dare to look deeper

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains scenes of violence, hints of alcohol consumption, scenes of blood and hints of sexual scenes.

short_description: Prince Fescillia’s mission in Klodan was meant to bring peace, but the cold hides something far more sinister. Alongside his friend Leonar, he becomes entangled in shadows of the past and meet a mysterious warrior in a beastly mask. Five paths, one fateful choice… Will the prince find the right one?
